title: Required CI omits the Astro build that gates every Vercel deployment
blast: A broken marketing dependency, Astro page, or marketing lockfile can pass required CI and merge while Vercel fails before building the application, leaving the previous production release live. The current source has a separate marketing package/build that npm run build does not exercise.
verify: node -e 'const fs=require('"'"'node:fs'"'"'),assert=require('"'"'node:assert/strict'"'"');const ci=fs.readFileSync('"'"'.github/workflows/ci-gate.yml'"'"','"'"'utf8'"'"');const app=require('"'"'./package.json'"'"').scripts.build;console.log('"'"'CI build command: npm run build'"'"');console.log('"'"'Root build script:'"'"',app);console.log('"'"'Vercel runs marketing npm ci + npm run build before the app (scripts/vercel-build.cjs:48-52).'"'"');assert.match(ci,/working-directory:\s*marketing|npm --prefix marketing|npm run build:vercel|cd marketing/, '"'"'Required CI must exercise the separate marketing build used by deployment'"'"');'

title: Fresh migration replay creates partner_users twice and cannot complete
blast: Provisioning a clean database or rebuilding schema from migration history fails at the second unconditional CREATE TABLE, blocking reproducible staging/recovery. Existing production deployments with both migrations already recorded are not claimed broken. This was verified by SQL inspection and a read-only duplicate-DDL assertion, not by mutating a database.
evidence: prisma/migrations/20260319100000_add_partner_users/migration.sql:2 and prisma/migrations/20260320000000_add_partner_users/migration.sql:2 both unconditionally create the same table and repeat indexes/constraints; graph/evidence/clm_deps_duplicate_partner_users_replay.txt (assertion exits 1); AGENTS.md local setup already documents PostgreSQL 42P07/P3018 for this replay.
verify: node -e 'const fs=require('"'"'node:fs'"'"'),assert=require('"'"'node:assert/strict'"'"');const files=['"'"'prisma/migrations/20260319100000_add_partner_users/migration.sql'"'"','"'"'prisma/migrations/20260320000000_add_partner_users/migration.sql'"'"'];const creates=files.filter(p=>/^CREATE TABLE \"partner_users\"/m.test(fs.readFileSync(p,'"'"'utf8'"'"')));console.log('"'"'Unconditional CREATE TABLE partner_users migrations:'"'"',JSON.stringify(creates));assert.ok(creates.length<=1, '"'"'Migration replay creates partner_users twice without an intervening drop or existence guard'"'"');'
